candidate_window.date_policy: never invent sessions; resolve exact session dates from official calendar

provider_lineage.timezone: Asia/Jakarta-compatible UTC+7; preserve provider epoch and convert explicitly

official_open.meaning: official daily opening price for the exact exchange session

tv_regular_open.source: raw first chronological TradingView regular-session bar Open
tv_regular_open.meaning: provider observation at the first returned regular-session bar; not proven to be the opening auction

tv_intraday_hlc.source: raw TradingView regular-session intraday High/Low/Close path
tv_intraday_hlc.meaning: raw bar-level path for the exact session and timeframe

tv_intraday_volume.meaning: provider-native volume units, preserved without scaling or substitution

tv_regular_open_to_first_hour_close_retu.meaning: provider-regular-session return; never an official-auction return

path_volatility.formula: sum(abs(log(close_t / close_(t-1)))) over chronological raw bars
requires: at least two valid raw closes

mae_mfe.formula: min/max path excursion relative to official_open, kept as separate MAE and MFE fields

drawdown.formula: maximum peak-to-subsequent-trough decline over chronological raw closes
requires: at least two valid raw closes

hlc_path.formula: raw chronological High/Low/Close vectors and deterministic aggregates only

volume_path.formula: raw cumulative volume, bar-count, and within-session volume timing in provider units

regular_first_bar_movement.meaning: regular first-bar movement, not opening-auction movement
requires: first regular bar has positive Open

session_admission_contract.ACTIVE: regular-session path is required; missing provider path is a true provider miss
session_admission_contract.NO_TRADE: no price-path feature is created; absence of provider bars is not a provider miss
session_admission_contract.SUSPENDED_OR_NON_ACTIVE: exclude from model-safe path view and quarantine any provider bars
session_admission_contract.UNKNOWN: fail closed; do not count as covered or no-trade until independently resolved
session_admission_contract.exactness: ticker/security identity, official session date, timezone conversion, and regular-session boundary must all match exactly
session_admission_contract.corporate_actions: official split/reverse-split evidence remains a separate quarantine/key; no ratio-based adjustment

prohibited_semantics: treat tv_regular_open as the official opening auction
previous-close-as-Open, interpolation, forward-fill, averaging, or voting
opening-auction microstructure feature without an actual auction source/flag
silently mixing extended/pre-market bars into the regular path
using dividends, Adj Close, or inferred split ratios to repair raw OHLC
rescaling provider volume to force canonical parity
converting missing or ambiguous activity evidence into NO_TRADE
using unresolved sessions as covered evidence

independent_activity_resolution.official_metrics: Volume = 0, Value = 0, Frequency = 0 on exact official IDX Stock Summary rows
independent_activity_resolution.scope: regular-market activity only; no claim about all boards or NonRegular activity

non_blocking_semantic_constraints: TV60 first Open is not proven to represent official auction/opening price
2021/2024 1m/5m extended probes remained unresolved after symbol load
a TradingView provider-session bar must not be described as 60 minutes of continuous IDX trading
clock-time microstructure and volume-timing features require explicit session segmentation
